title: Personal Branding
subtitle: Personal website, portfolio and interactive CV development
description:
I developed a complete personal branding to promote myself in a creative and coherent way. I created an interactive and animated resume with an artistic collage style that reflects my identity and skills.

I also designed an animated portfolio, very visual and interactive, where each project has its own detailed section. All the content was integrated into a personal website with a unified and coherent aesthetic. In addition, I included cartoon-like cards that represent me in different roles.

The goal was to show my creative and technical capabilities through the design and functioning of the site itself.
